title: Handoff / Supply Chain Agent

subjects.identity: One orange-and-white articulated industrial robot arm, one small apricot parcel, and one low autonomous carrier in a miniature logistics bay.

style: Premium isometric miniature warehouse, pale lavender and matte white architecture, restrained cobalt and apricot route lights.
motion_intent: The arm lowers its gripper, closes around the same parcel, and lifts it a few centimeters with plausible joint articulation and contact.
scene: Locked three-quarter isometric camera on one miniature loading bay, soft daylight and physical shadows. Active machinery center-right; left 35 percent quiet lavender for editable HTML copy.
continuity: Same one arm, one parcel, one carrier, same dimensions, orange markings and bay architecture throughout.
The gripper visibly closes on the parcel; parcel does not float or clip through the fingers.
Only the arm and parcel move; carrier and architecture remain stationary.
No readable signage, numbers, logos, UI, baked copy or camera movement.

destination.site_role: Scroll-controlled operations chapter in a complete personal website; project claims and metrics are editable HTML.
destination.mobile: Contain full 16:9 image without cropping, with HTML project details in normal flow.
destination.scroll_container: 300svh section with 100svh sticky stage, two viewport heights of travel.
